{{Quote|I'm enjoying the Republic's hospitality. Their ''R5'' units serve the most delightful ''mince nerf stew''. It's almost palatable.|Arlain Zee, to Volan Das|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Nerf steak stew''' was a [[Stew/Legends|stew]] made from [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]]. It could be served chilled, and packaged in a can. [[Ben Skywalker]] ate a can of this stew on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], during his [[Mission for the Amulet of Kalara|mission to retrieve the Amulet of Kalara]] for [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].

Minced [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] stew was one of the meals served to [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].
